title: Cross-modal triage network: a multimodal deep learning framework for severity-based triage and visual explainability in chest radiographs
abstract: arXiv:2609.04357v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Purpose: Increased number of chest radiograph (CXR) scans create a triage bottleneck, queueing urgent examinations behind routine ones. Existing AI tools are predominantly unimodal binary classifiers lacking severity awareness, and multimodal systems are rarely benchmarked against expert radiologists. To this end, we developed a multimodal deep learning framework for joint severity triage, pathology detection, and native visual explanation. Approach: We propose the cross-modal triage network (CMTN), fusing a Swin Transformer V2 visual encoder with a PubMedBERT text encoder via gated cross-attention. The CMTN was trained on 34,639 image-text pairs (12,489 patients) from MIMIC-CXR-JPG, optimizing an ordinal focal loss for four-tier severity triage and binary cross-entropy for 14 pathologies. translated_title: 跨模态分诊网络：一种用于胸部X线片严重程度分诊与可视化解释的多模态深度学习框架
translated_abstract: 目的：胸部X线片（CXR）扫描数量的增加造成了分诊瓶颈，导致紧急检查被排在常规检查之后。现有的AI工具主要是缺乏严重程度感知的单模态二元分类器，而多模态系统很少与专家放射科医生进行基准对比。为此，我们开发了一个多模态深度学习框架，用于联合实现严重程度分诊、病理检测和原生视觉解释。方法：我们提出了跨模态分诊网络（CMTN），通过门控交叉注意力将Swin Transformer V2视觉编码器与PubMedBERT文本编码器融合。CMTN在来自MIMIC-CXR-JPG的34,639对图像-文本对（12,489名患者）上进行训练，采用有序焦点损失优化四级严重程度分诊，并采用二元交叉熵优化14种病理检测。除了定量基准测试外，注意力热图还与一位盲法专家放射科医生进行了对比评估，该评估在一项比较模……的两阶段临床审计中进行。（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出跨模态分诊网络（CMTN），通过门控交叉注意力融合Swin Transformer V2视觉编码器与PubMedBERT文本编码器，在MIMIC-CXR-JPG数据上实现对胸部X线片的四级严重程度分诊、14种病理检测和可视化解释，并与盲法专家放射科医生进行对比评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Cross-Modal Triage Network (CMTN), which fuses a Swin Transformer V2 visual encoder with a PubMedBERT text encoder via gated cross-attention to achieve four-tier severity triage, 14-pathology detection, and visual explainability for chest radiographs, benchmarked against a blinded expert radiologist.
